note: What the deployed shader set declares, read from build/vkquake/generated: five shaders need an input attachment (the read R10 landed), two use textureSize, and the six the driver refuses - three 5347 addressing-model and three 4472 bindless-store - are all ray-query paths the port never creates.
human_check: This record is an instrument rather than a console run: it reads OpCapability out of every deployed shader and names what the driver will be asked to compile. It exists because a run once spent eight minutes and a console cycle to learn which shader declares an input attachment. Five do - postprocess_frag and the two OIT resolves with their MSAA twins - and the six that this driver refuses (5347 addressing model, 4472 bindless store) are all ray-tracing paths, created only when vulkan_globals.ray_query is true, which no run of this port makes true: that is why the next run is expected to reach a frame rather than a refusal. The capability *names* were corrected at this revision - four were written from memory and wrong (35, 46, 49, 61) and ../PS5_Vulkan's own table (f9131e5) has them right; the numbers come from the SPIR-V itself. A declaration is not a failure by itself, and a scan read while a build is regenerating the directory is not a scan: the settled set is 67 shaders, 20 declaring more than Shader.
